at-0001.title: Round money only with round_money
at-0001.content: Always round monetary results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

at-0006.title: Compute periods via timedelta floor division
at-0006.content: Compute subscription period offsets the way `current_period` does: build `length = timedelta(days=sub.period_days)` and use `(at - start) // length` to get the period index.

at-0007.title: Money operations take keyword-only idempotency_key
at-0007.content: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check it first, before state validation: scan `ledgerly.audit.events(<event_type>)` for a matching key and return the original record without reapplying. Pass `idempotency_key` into the `audit.record(...)` call (INC-204 double-refund incident).
